description: This file is a shell script used for generating a module index by searching through the Android source tree for makefiles (.mk files) and extracting module and package names. It automates the process of creating an index of modules and packages for development purposes, specifically for the Android Open Source Project's build system.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The script's main execution flow that sets up variables, finds makefiles, extracts module and package names, filters directories, and measures execution time.
